changelog: Add: Daily Report Card module — a new sidebar page for the pre-market plan / post-market review workflow, per build briefing. Header (date, process-based overall grade, manual + auto P&L, morning temperature, sleep quality), one enforced primary process goal, standing mantras checked off daily, five free-text sections, and repeatable ticker rows with chart image uploads. Ten new tables (migrations/2026_09_23_0001_create_report_card_tables.sql): report_cards, report_card_blocks, report_card_templates(+blocks), report_card_mantras(+checks), report_card_tickers(+images), report_card_ai_reviews, report_card_ai_findings

Add: dynamic per-day session blocks (ReportCardController.php) — not the reference card's fixed US-equity blocks. Full CRUD, drag-reorder, 0-12 blocks per day, overlaps allowed (non-blocking warning), midnight-crossing blocks valid. Blocks are copied from a template into a card once at creation (weekday_default match -> user's is_default -> blank day) and never referenced again — editing a template never rewrites a past card, editing a day never rewrites the template. Five seed templates (Full day/London only/NY only/Light day/No-trade day) lazy-seeded per user on first use, since report_card_templates.user_id is NOT NULL and a migration can't seed rows for users that don't exist yet

Add: journal integration — a trade is attributed to whichever block's UTC window its time_in falls inside (or to an explicit Unassigned bucket, which is itself the signal of unplanned trading); pnl_auto is a live SUM(net_pnl) of the day's closed trades, never stored, shown alongside the manual pnl override; a trade-count guard reads the existing challenge_limits table (tradeLimitStatus(), shared with the Auto Risk Calculator) rather than hardcoding a 2/day-4/week limit

Add: AI Review (ReportCardAiController.php) — one Anthropic Messages API call per review sees behaviour (trades: risk sizing, R, exit quality, gate/tag strategy-variable answers, time gaps, block attribution) and thinking (the card's own text/grades) in the same payload, with a forced tool call guaranteeing structured JSON back. Produces alignment_score, discipline_score, and named contradictions/behavior_patterns/thinking_patterns/strengths/risks, each with cited evidence, exploded into report_card_ai_findings (queryable across months, so a repeated mistake becomes a fact, not a feeling). Re-running a review always inserts a new row; a failed run leaves status=failed with error_message and the card still renders

Add: report_card_cron.php — token-protected entry point (same pattern as migrate.php) for the nightly/weekly AI review runs, meant to be hit by a cPanel Cron Job; this hosting has no queue infrastructure for a real background worker

Add: History view (streak, alignment-score-over-time chart, per-day table) and Templates view (manage session templates and their blocks) as internal tabs on the same Report Card page — this app has no client-side URL router (index.php's showPage() only swaps page visibility, no pushState), so the briefing's /report-card/{date}-style routes are implemented as view state on one sidebar page instead of separate routes
